value.rationale: For the canonical three-dimensional cube, the first nontrivial matching-complex homology module of dimension four splits into geometrically meaningful translation-parity and axial-vector parts. The distinction is invisible in known Betti numbers and has precise consequences: antipodal quotient rational degree-two rank three but full-symmetry quotient reduced rank zero. This is a complete natural small-object symmetry classification, not a random table or a claimed family theorem.
